Scenarios.Name: Apartment Morning
Scenarios.Description: Begin at home with time to prepare before the neighborhood changes.

Scenarios.Name: Street Commute
Scenarios.Description: Begin outside with the city already moving around you.

Scenarios.Name: Late Shift
Scenarios.Description: Begin near the shops after working through the night.

Professions.Name: Mechanic
Professions.Description: You know machines, tools, and how to make broken things work.

Professions.Name: Nurse
Professions.Description: You can treat injuries and keep calm when other people cannot.

Professions.Name: Shop Worker
Professions.Description: You know stores, stockrooms, customers, and the local routine.

Professions.Name: Police Officer
Professions.Description: You have training, authority, and obligations to the people nearby.

Professions.Name: Journalist
Professions.Description: You notice details, ask difficult questions, and know how to find people.

Professions.Name: Drifter
Professions.Description: You have few obligations and know how to live with very little.

Backgrounds.Name: Local Resident
Backgrounds.Description: You know the streets and have a place nearby that feels like home.

Backgrounds.Name: Night Worker
Backgrounds.Description: You are used to empty streets, odd hours, and seeing trouble first.

Backgrounds.Name: Medical Family
Backgrounds.Description: Care work was part of your life long before the emergency began.

Backgrounds.Name: Unpaid Debts
Backgrounds.Description: You know who is looking for you, and what you owe them.

Backgrounds.Name: Technical School
Backgrounds.Description: You learned enough practical work to be useful in a crisis.

Backgrounds.Name: Sheltered Upbringing
Backgrounds.Description: The city is more unfamiliar to you than you expected.

Backgrounds.Name: Streetwise
Backgrounds.Description: You learned to read a room before anyone had to explain it.

Backgrounds.Name: Quiet Life
Backgrounds.Description: You had a normal life and a normal plan until this morning.

Traits.Name: Light Sleeper
Traits.Description: You wake more easily when danger approaches.

Traits.Name: Strong Back
Traits.Description: You can carry more before becoming encumbered.

Traits.Name: Pacifist
Traits.Description: Violence is difficult for you to choose.

Traits.Name: Empathetic
Traits.Description: Other people's fear affects you more strongly.

Traits.Name: Night Owl
Traits.Description: You function better during the night.

Traits.Name: Quick
Traits.Description: You recover from actions slightly faster.

Traits.Name: Clumsy
Traits.Description: Difficult physical actions are less reliable.

Skills.Name: Smash
Skills.Description: Force doors and break objects effectively.

Skills.Name: Melee
Skills.Description: Fight with improvised and conventional weapons.

Skills.Name: Survival
Skills.Description: Find resources and manage scarce supplies.

Skills.Name: Observation
Skills.Description: Notice movement, danger, and useful details.

Skills.Name: Cooking
Skills.Description: Prepare food safely and stretch ingredients.

Skills.Name: Lockpicking
Skills.Description: Open simple locks without making much noise.

Skills.Name: Running
Skills.Description: Move quickly and manage fatigue while doing so.

Skills.Name: Computers
Skills.Description: Use and repair common early-2000s computer systems.

Skills.Name: Stealth
Skills.Description: Move and act without drawing attention.
